Before age 12? Oh, definitely. Yeah, even back in elementary school. I remember my mom showing me these old report cards, and every single teacher wrote the exact same thing. Like, "She's very bright, but..." And then it was always about how I constantly lost my worksheets or how I'd rush through the directions and do the whole thing wrong. Oh, and my desk! My desk was a disaster zone. I remember in third grade, my teacher, Mrs. Gable—she was so nice, she always smelled like lavender and she had this really fluffy golden retriever that she brought in for show-and-tell once. His name was Barnaby, and he was the softest dog I've ever pet. I begged my parents for a golden retriever after that, but my dad is super allergic to dogs. Like, his eyes swell up and he gets hives. So we ended up getting a lizard instead. A bearded dragon named Spike. He was cool, I guess, but you can't really cuddle a lizard, you know? They just kind of sit there under their heat lamp looking grumpy. 

But yeah, Mrs. Gable used to make me stay inside during recess sometimes just to clean out my desk because it was so stuffed with crumpled papers and broken crayons that I couldn't even find my assignments. So, yeah, it's definitely been happening since I was little.
